concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balanceplatform-webhooks-latest-post-balanceplatform-balanceaccountpayoutscheduleautoapplication-failed]] — 2026-09-15-captured Balance Platform event for failed automatic application of a managed payout schedule to a balance account, with optional schedule/account/reason/counterparty identifiers; this is configuration failure, not payout execution.

- [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balanceplatform-webhooks-latest-post-balanceplatform-balanceaccountpayoutscheduleautoapplication-failed]] — 2026-09-15-captured managed payout schedule automatic-application failure webhook for a balance account; optional reason and resource IDs do not establish payout execution or bank receipt.
